title: Add free-text notes to orders
task: Sales wants to attach a short free-text note to an order when creating it, and see it on the order detail endpoint.
plan:
1. Migration 0004_order_notes.sql: `ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN notes TEXT;` (nullable, no default). Down: drop the column.
2. src/routes/orders.ts: extend createOrderSchema with `notes: z.string().max(2000).optional()`, pass it into the INSERT. GET /orders/:id already returns `SELECT *`, so the note comes back automatically.
3. Add a test in tests/orders.test.ts asserting that POST /orders forwards notes to the INSERT params and that a 2001-char note is rejected with 400.
4. No UI change in this iteration; OrderTable does not show notes.

must_identify: Nullable TEXT column without default is a metadata-only change on Postgres, so the 41M-row orders table is not rewritten (runbook warns about ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT); this is the right migration shape
Migrations run before the rolling deploy, so the old app version must keep working with the extra column; SELECT * and INSERT with explicit columns both do, so compatibility holds
nice_to_have: Notes are free text visible to anyone who can read the order: members only see their own orders, so exposure is bounded; mention PII/retention only briefly
GET /orders list also uses SELECT *, so notes leak into the list payload for admins; probably fine but worth a sentence
Zod max(2000) vs TEXT column: no DB-level limit, acceptable
should_not: Classify an additive nullable column as HIGH
Demand a rollback plan beyond the down migration
Ask the user whether to use TEXT vs VARCHAR
human_decisions: Optional: whether notes may contain customer PII (affects the 7-year retention story); acceptable to flag, not required
fixture_facts: orders table defined in src/db/migrations/0001_init.sql; ~41M rows per docs/ops-runbook.txt
docs/ops-runbook.txt: migrations run before rolling deploy; ADD COLUMN with DEFAULT caused an 11-minute lock incident
